scripts.format: node scripts/rust-check.mjs format && prettier --write tests scripts rust-tests rust/src/runtime *.json *.jsonc migrations/*.sql --ignore-unknown
scripts.format:check: node scripts/rust-check.mjs format:check && prettier --check tests scripts rust-tests rust/src/runtime *.json *.jsonc --ignore-unknown
scripts.test: node scripts/rust-check.mjs test && npm run build:rust && node --test rust-tests/*.test.ts tests/*.test.ts
